The next stop is Finnegan's Wake Tavern, where there are reports of shadows moving, loud bangs coming from upstairs, and a glass breaking on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Chester County, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennhurst Asylum. Pennhurst was forcibly shut down in 1986 for mistreatment of patients, overcrowding and abuse. Some of the claims are screams being heard, people being pushed, doors opening and closing on their own, shadows, and apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to America's most haunted city, New Orleans, to investigate the Old U.S. Mint. This mint-turned-museum has lots of reported activity, including shadow figures, thuds, noises, female apparitions, lights flickering and alarms going off. Steve and Tango start off their night on the second floor. While the guys are walking around a door suddenly opens and then slams shut all on its own, leaving the guys speechless.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode on Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to South Dakota for the first time to investigate the Alex Johnson Hotel, a place filled with history. programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Prospect, Maine to investigate Fort Knox, built before the Civil War to protect the Penobscot narrows. programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor. Jason and Grant get started in the Quest Gallery, and they see a chain moving on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels for the first time to Hawaii to investigate the Pacific Aviation Museum at Pearl Harbor in Honolulu. Steve can't fly, so he isn't able to make the trip, but Britt is helping out, as well as Destination Truth's Josh Gates. Some of the activity that has been reported is whispers, cold air being felt, apparitions, and cameras being turned on and off on command.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

But as the plot thickens and the heat intensifies, Shawn's credibility will most certainly be challenged. He'll need to dig deep within himself to stop his life from spinning wildly out of control. This thrilling drama will test his limits as he struggles to find the balance between who he is and who he imagines himself to be.

programme.title: Noxious

programme.desc: Memphis homicide detective, Danielle, leads the country in closed cases. After seven years being a solo act, she partners with Aaron, an experienced narcotics police officer looking for a change in career to homicide. The two are tasked with the toughest case in either of their careers involving a mysterious masked group causing mass murders. Their only clues are the calling cards of the accomplices; red wrist bands and black poker chips.

programme.title: Krooked Lines
programme.desc: It's a race against time in this fast moving suspense drama where the lines between cops, criminals, love, and loyalty intersect. Two friends, one motivated by the law, the other motivated by money, try to bring down a human trafficking ring, while dealing with the death of a lover, and revelation of an undercover affair. The bond must survive, even when there is no one to trust.

programme.title: Art of Love
programme.desc: After a government contracted hit goes wrong, the collateral damage causes Lucas Alba to retire from working for the company. He may be done, but his past eventually catches up with him. The ensuing consequences put the life of him, and anyone close to him in Jeopardy.

programme.title: Good Deed Gone Bad
programme.desc: Tyler, a tech nerd working in corporate America stumbles across a random cellphone in the back of his uber car on his way home from work. Hesitant to turn the device to his shifty driver, he decides that with his knowledge and understanding of technology, he can find the owner on his own. Not knowing that returning this phone could very well cost him his life, he pursues the journey of doing a good deed that will go very bad.

programme.title: Outrighteous
programme.desc: Hard working Simone and flamboyant Angela may be like fire and ice, but they still know what it means to be sistas. However, when they both fall for the same man, their life-long friendship turns into an all-out war of the most 'outrighteous' kind. In this comical duel of good deeds will either woman get the man of their dreams?

programme.title: Single Saved and Searching
programme.desc: Leah puts all of her trust in God when it came to her relationships. For some reason her relationships still weren't working out. After a big breakup with a long time boyfriend Leah sends out a prayer that would turn into an unexpected journey. God gives Leah a gift that makes men appear at her will, but Leah still questions why God gave her this gift.

programme.title: When Love Comes Knocking
programme.desc: Veronica Richardson, a girl who has never been with a good man, is caught off guard when true love finds its way to her doorstep. It is up to her if she wants to let it in or shut it out. Damaged and heartbroken from a past childhood friend, Veronica had lost all hope to ever be able to love again.

programme.title: Saints 2 Aints
programme.desc: Stuck in a loveless marriage, Chiffona pines for her first love Orvalle and laments to her girlfriends, but plans on moving to a new town to try and save her marriage. Her friend Gevia says she has found love, but keeps his identity a secret. After time passes, a now single Chiffona, moves back to town and learns Gevia's mystery man is none other than Orvalle.

programme.title: Traces of Indignity
programme.desc: Dr. Augusta Weber has traveled the world over promoting her books, DVD's and selling out public speaking events. She is a retired College Professor who is greatly admired by all. Although Dr. Weber is an advocate for being straight-forward, open and honest, she is protecting a deep, dark secret that has plagued her for years. An aggressive journalist, Ruby, is determined to denounce Dr. Weber's character by uncovering the truth and scoring the next big story.

programme.title: Irreversible Desires
programme.desc: Three couples, who have been long time friends, find themselves exploring sex in a new way. Soon the journey for each one takes a turn for the worse from when they first started causing jealousy, contempt, rage, and murder.

programme.title: Hanging on to Love
programme.desc: Serial dater, Jewel, cannot seem to find love, until she starts to fall for the owner of her dry cleaners.

programme.title: Sweet Mahogany: Pure Indulgence
programme.desc: Mahogany Andrews appears to be in the fight for her life as she is battling Tony Hawkins for custody of their daughter, Rachel. However, another fight is beginning to ensue as Cassie Pearson is doing whatever it takes to keep her entire family, which includes Mahogany, together and Khalil Pearson is battling internally to figure out what he truly wants and needs out of life and his marriage.

programme.title: She Sexy
programme.desc: An actress accepts a writer's invitation to become his muse and inspire his latest romance novel. Soon, their relationship evolves into something more.

programme.title: 3 Way: College Edition
programme.desc: College freshman, Daniella, and her boyfriend, Franklin, set off to separate colleges in Atlanta. When Daniella finds out that her boyfriend is cheating on her, she finds comfort, and connection in her roommate, and her roommate's boyfriend. Will she survive freshman year once her ex-boyfriend wants her back and finds out about her college 3 WAY?

programme.title: Dirty Thirty
programme.desc: Naomi Turner is celebrating her 30th birthday with family and friends. A night full of alcohol and drugs leads to a hangover the next morning with no memory of the night before. Soon they find out that Naomi is missing. As her husband Justin is searching for an answer, he finds out nothing but secrets, lies and Naomi's dead body. Justin is the prime suspect and has to prove his innocence while he searches for who killed his wife.

programme.title: Fixation 2: Uprising
programme.desc: Three years after the accused Grant Park killer is released from prison. FBI Agent Dana Malone takes a special interest into the case. She uncovers a murderous secret that takes a mother searching for her daughter in a whole new direction. Agent Malone discovers the real truth behind Samantha's disappearance and how social media plays a big influence.

Ciera tries to make the relationship work but Byron doesn't want to change his ways. Ciera decides to call it quits with Byron. While jogging in the park one day, Ciera runs into her high school sweetheart, Curtis. When Byron finds out about Ciera's new man, he begins to destroy everything in her life. Ciera must protect her baby and her life before Byron kills everyone she loves.

With their lives on the line, they must figure out how to make sixty thousand dollars in two weeks, all while plotting their revenge. When one of them falls for the mark, things get more complicated.

As they each struggle to hold on to their relationships the women can't help but wonder if it's even possible to find lasting love, especially for a black woman?

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As part of his planning for summer Monty begins to sow annual climbers and gets started on tidying and mulching his borders. We also meet clematis enthusiast, Mike Brown, whose collection fills his garden with colour all summer long, and amongst the brutalist architecture of London's Barbican, Nick Bailey, head gardener of the Chelsea Physic Garden, discovers a hidden tropical oasis.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: The first big gardening weekend of the year gets underway with Monty dividing perennials and giving plenty of tips for how we can kick-start the garden for the season ahead. As millions of bedding plants are poised for planting in our pots and borders, Joe Swift visits a major grower to find out how they are produced and what drives the demand.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gets to work in his wildlife garden to ensure that there are plenty of plants in flower for early pollinators. Carol Klein meets Stuart Donachie who has embraced every planting opportunity in his shady garden in Herefordshire, and Frances Tophill invites viewers to grow easy summer vegetables along with her as she trials varieties for taste and productivity at RHS Rosemoor.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty starts a new project, a cutting garden, and gives advice on what to grow to provide plenty of cut flowers for gorgeous summer bouquets. We visit Cumbria to meet Jack Gott, who has been passionate about that most flamboyant of flowers, the dahlia, for more than forty years and has over a thousand plants in his garden; and James Alexander-Sinclair celebrates a harbinger of Spring, the ephemeral cherry blossom, at Alnwick Castle in Northumberland.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gets his new vegetable garden underway by making raised beds. He also offers advice on how to cut back herbs. Nick Bailey marks the 400th anniversary of the death of William Shakespeare when he investigates the fact and the fiction behind the Bard's potions and poisons, at the Chelsea Physic Garden; and we visit Pashley Manor in East Sussex to unearth the story behind the planting of over 25,000 tulips.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the growing season picks up a pace, Monty is sowing vegetables and planting out the scented plants, which he brought back from the Malvern Spring Festival. Carol is delving into the hedgerows and rooting at the bases of walls, fences and trees as she begins her journey to investigate why plants thrive in challenging conditions. We also return to Sissinghurst to find out about the changes Troy Scott-Smith is making to the world famous white garden.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow Monty's focus is on summer when he plants up containers for colour in the Jewel Garden. He also turns his attention to overcrowded ornamental grasses which, now they are beginning to put on growth, need to be split and replanted. Continuing her search for finding the right plant for the right place, Carol takes a close look at why plants survive in the cracks and crevices of walls and gives her recommendations for garden plants that will thrive in similar conditions.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow Monty is planting bulbs in pots and around the garden for an explosion of spring colour. Mark Lane is in Oxfordshire looking at how ornamental grasses can be used in planting design to create exciting combinations.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond celebrate the horticultural genius of William Robinson in the gardens of his former home, Gravetye Manor in Sussex. There's also a passionate grower in London who uses every available space in his garden to grow a vast range of vegetables.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: In the second of her films about botany, Carol Klein goes underground to unravel the mysteries of roots and why they are so important to the health of our plants. programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty Don meets two sets of gardeners who are desperate for his help and advice so as to turn their outside spaces into dream gardens. programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces

Will Monty be able to guide the sisters to a Mediterranean style success?

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: In Brighton determined duo Helen and Dax have their hands full with twins, one of whom has special needs. Meanwhile in High Wycombe, newly single Valerie is looking for a fresh lease of life.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With warmer days just around the corner, Adam Frost takes stock of his borders and plans ahead for some year-round interest. He also adds some soft fruit to his veg garden and gets some seed sowing underway.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty continues his travels to learn about the art of Japanese stonemasonry and the famous tea ceremonies and their accompanying gardens, before finally taking a lesson in the delicate art of traditional flower arranging.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a powerbase of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.
programme.sub-title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As summer gets into full swing, there is plenty for Monty to be doing at Longmeadow. He gets to grips with summer pruning as he tackles his espaliered pear trees. programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It is the autumn equinox and Monty celebrates the season's apple bounty. Monty also plans for Christmas when he plants bulbs to brighten dark winter days, and he gives advice on planting garlic for the following year.

programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Starting his journey at the sole surviving garden of the 1600s, Levens Hall in Cumbria, Monty sets out to investigate what the gardens of this age would have looked like and what influenced and inspired their creation.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty bases himself at Rousham House in Oxfordshire, designed by one of the first practitioners of the landscape movement, William Kent. It has survived almost unchanged since its completion in 1741.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the extraordinary transformations that occurred throughout the 19th century. As a result of an expanding empire, scientific and technological innovation and social change, British gardens became more exotic, more colourful and more widely accessible than ever before.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his journey through Britain's gardening heritage by looking at how the nation's gardens have evolved over the last hundred years. He looks at the profound effect that two world wars had on the attitude to gardens and gardening.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When council clerk Martin Barrett is shot dead, Barnaby and Jones discover that he was an expert blackmailer. They investigate which of his victims hated him enough to kill him, and the trail leads to Fennacombe Bay. Why are Richard and Maggie Florian spending so much time at sea, and could police committee chairman Sir John Waverley have a scandalous past? With the help of Barnaby, they intend to find out.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A battle of the sexes which has raged in Broughton since the First World War comes to a head when ageing feminist Mildred Danvers is found dead after returning to her childhood home. As Barnaby investigates, the misogynist vicar Rev Gantis is shot through the head during a humiliating donkey race at the village fair. Is the killer on the side of the men or women - or do tragedies in Broughton's past hold the answer?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Controversial plans to build a supermarket in Elverton-cum-Latterly lead to murder when a man is stabbed to death and the pollution advisor for the site seems to be spending more time with the women of the village than at work. Can Barnaby and Jones discover the truth and learn what is really polluting Elverton?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Midsomer Worthy's baritone Connor Simpson is killed just days before a competition, the rest of the choir, including Joyce Barnaby, are in fear for their lives. Barnaby and Jones investigate and find an atmosphere of bitter rivalry and tense marital relationships. Then, there's another murder and the race is on to catch the killer before the choral showdown.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby begins to question the guilt of a Midsomer Malham woman who is on trial for the murder of her best friend. The evidence is stacked against her, but she doesn't appear deluded or obsessed with the dead woman's husband as the prosecution claim. With the help of a frail pensioner - the key witness, can Barnaby and Jones discover what really happened on the night of the murder?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a survivalist is found murdered in his bombproof shelter, Barnaby unravels a dark conspiracy to reveal how far people will go to escape the end of the world.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Gated estate Challis Court is a tight-knit community for retired police officers, but when a new arrival is found dead, the other residents regard the murder as an affront. Barnaby realizes that the killer is likely an ex-police officer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Pastry chef Chrissie Larkton's mill has been in her family for centuries. She restored it and turned it into a thriving online business, but the popularity has overshadowed Lower Blissingham, and many of the villagers are not happy about it.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Elverton-Cum-Latterly battle in the Dominoes Competition that dates back decades, but when the event occurs the same night as a drag queen fundraiser for a terminally ill teenager, it results in a deadly clash of cultures.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Barnabys plan to renew their wedding vows for their 25th anniversary when Tom is distracted by a murder of a dying man committed with an Indian sword in Badger's Drift.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The naked body of a young woman is found strangled in a local woodland nine years after three identical murders took place there. As DCI Barnaby and DS Troy investigate the killings, they are led further and further into the murky, clandestine world of Midsomer Worthy.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Mysterious events and the discovery of his relative's body lead the residents of Aspern Tallow to believe that Jonathan Lowrie's ghost is at large in their community. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy attempt to determine whether these strange occurrences are supernatural or if there is a more rational explanation.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the sleepy village of Martyr Warren, two opposing groups of travellers have set up home. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy are called in to investigate when the local magistrate, principal adversary of the new arrivals in the village, is found shot dead at his home.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Troy have to solve a double murder when a feisty former socialite and a Casanova are found bludgeoned to death. However, the motives for the murders seem disparate, and there are several people who are suspected of involvement.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby investigates a death which looks like suicide. The dead man was a troubled and depressed gambler on a losing streak, but Barnaby's nose tells him to look for a murderer and then recognises someone from his past, in the shape of Dr Jane Moore.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby's wife, Joyce, finds a dead body on the Midsomer Florey village green while taking part in a watercolour painting class, recognising it as the elderly Miss Fairfax. Barnaby is given the case, then finds himself taken off it and replaced by a team from the National Intelligence Squad, while he is assigned to deal with a missing handbag.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The death of a young film star at the opening of a `satanic experience' at his family's ancestral home brings Barnaby and Troy to the feuding villages of Upper and Lower Warden. Here the Smythe-Websters are exploiting the work of celebrated `House of Satan' author Ellis Bell - but is there more to his legacy?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Julian Shepherd is found drowned, it seems as though he committed suicide due to all his money being tied up in Charles Edmonton's latest invention. When another man dies after poaching peregrine eggs from Charles's wife, Barnaby suspects foul play.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The peaceful setting of prestigious Whiteoaks Golf Club is rocked by death and controversy when a golfer is bludgeoned to death near the notorious 13th hole known as Crisp's Folly. Barnaby and Jones discover gambling is rife at the club - along with illegal money-lending and violent assault. Then, as the club considers giving ordinary villagers full membership rights, another golfer is killed.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby finds a tangled world of crime and intrigue in the art world. A recently discovered masterpiece by local artist Henry Hogson realises an impressive price at auction just hours before its previous owner is tortured and killed. Can Barnaby and Jones prevent the body count from rising further?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby's secret past as a spy is revealed when a former agent is found dead after a cricket match in Midsomer Parva. While locals blame the brutal killing on the `beast of Midsomer', Barnaby suspects otherwise. He soon finds links to a network of spies that operated in Cold War Berlin, but his investigation is obstructed at every turn.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Science fellow George Jeffers threatens to go public with what he believes is a potentially lethal software glitch in a new air traffic control system. American software boss Clinton Finn fears he will lose millions if the truth comes out and puts pressure on the University authorities, but when village schoolteacher Emily Harte is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby wonders if Jeffers was the real target.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The peace of Little Worthy is shattered by a bizarre murder when a man is found stabbed and tied down like Gulliver in Lilliput in the sleepy hamlet's model village. Barnaby and Jones are called in, and they find many secrets hidden behind the traditions, tourist attractions and tea rooms. Then, the killer strikes again. Can the detectives discover the truth about the residents of Little Worthy and solve the crimes?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A burglar known as `the Creeper' terrorises Midsomer as Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder of a dinner party guest at upper-crust Chettham Park House. The detectives discover a group of high society friends with links both to gangsters and the Chief Constable dating back to the 1960s, but do the friends also have secrets worth killing for?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Schoolteacher Connie Bishop keeps waking in the night, convinced she has an intruder. Just days later a local councillor, said to be obsessed with her, is found murdered in her garden. Is Connie the innocent victim she seems? Barnaby and Jones uncover jealous rivals, ruthless social climbers and a cottage with secrets as they search for the killer in Badger's Drift.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: New DCI John Barnaby is intrigued when he learns that the remains of famous racing driver Duncan Palmer have been discovered at Darnley Park School - 40 years after he was thought to have drowned in the Lake District. During the school's classic car show, racing legend Peter Fossett is annoyed that his fellow judge is club DJ Dave `Doggy' Day, who knows nothing about cars. Soon afterwards, Doggy is crushed to death.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A social services investigator calls on elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham, but he is sent away rudely by their daughter Selina and her husband Eddie Stanton. Artist Maggie Viviani also had a run-in with the investigator, so when his body is found in the river, they all come under suspicion. Barnaby learns that the Binghams never recovered from losing their elder daughter and son in a drowning accident.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Focaccia is an irresistible, crunchy Italian flatbread. It's great for sandwiches and even to stuff. Lidia begins by making a Classic Rosemary and Lemon Focaccia; she then moves on to a Filled Focaccia with Smoky Speck and Fontina Cheese. To finish these two lunchtime and snack favorites, she creates a Salad of Shrimp, Fava and Cranberry Beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: If there were another name for Lidia's family, it would be the gnocchi family. They love making them together AND eating them. Lidia starts with a Butternut Squash Gnocchi that is as soft as a feather and served with a velvety sage and butter sauce. Next, she prepares a Marinated Bread of Chicken Seared with Shiitake Mushrooms, Rosemary and Sage. Her sautéed earthy Brussels Sprouts are made with pepperoncino, garlic and walnuts. They are nutty AND spicy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Brodetto is a savory, soup fish preparation that can be found up and down the coast of Italy. Lidia makes her Brodetto with onion, scallion, clams and mussels and lots of parsley and pepperoncino. Lidia's Walnut Cake is delicate and nutty with just enough espresso to make it truly Italian.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everyone loves baked pasta, and in this episode, Lidia prepares a Baked Penne Dish with a comforting pork ragu and zucchini topped with a golden crust of cheese. She also makes an elegant Salad of Asparagus, Scallions and Boiled Egg and finishes the meal with a delicious and moist Chocolate Zucchini Cake

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Whether used in soups, roasted or stuffed, the Italians love their vegetables. In this episode, she makes a platter full of Roasted Peppers Stuffed with Tuna. She then creates a mellow dish of Savory Onions Stuffed with Lamb and Sweet Raisins. The Cauliflower and Tomato Soup is one that warms the heart and any kitchen table.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is a party in the air with an Italian flair. Lidia teaches the viewer several dishes that will work for any party - including a selection of varies cheese, cured meat and Giardiniera Style Vegetables; an easy and quick Sweet and Sour Zucchini Dish and lastly Stuffed Mushrooms made with a delicious mixture of scallions, red peppers and fresh parsley. Lastly there is still time for a delicious salad of poached seafood featuring shrimp, mussels and calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: "Alla Parmigiana" is a technique applied in many southern Italian dishes that is all about layering simple bold flavors.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The egg is a staple ingredient in any kitchen and should not be overlooked or overcooked. In this episode, Lidia shows you the classic technique of poaching an egg and making a Warm Mushroom Salad: a bed of frisee with a warm medley of mixed wild mushrooms, pancetta and a poached egg; Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce: a simple and delicious tomato Sauce poached egg served with slices of grilled country bread and Brutti ma Buoni, a classic Italian hazelnut cookie made with meringue.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Salting your food is an important step in any kitchen, and the type of salt used can make a huge difference in your meal. Today's menu includes: Salted Cod Fritters: Crispy chunky cod fritters made for the perfect salty snack; Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce: an iconic Italian pasta dish with penne rigate in a creamy pink vodka sauce; Beef Chuck and Beer; a rick and flavorful braise that will beckon everyone to the table.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: They have been called the "gnocchi family", and in this episode, Lidia shares two of her more unusual versions of this dish: Her Butternut Squash Gnocchi are light and slightly sweet as they showcase this welcome vegetable in the potato mix. Her next dish is Plum Gnocchi, which is typical of her homeland and even sweeter, sometimes eaten as a dessert. Made with toasted breadcrumbs, cinnamon and butter, it doesn't get any better than this!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love to drink wine with their meals and cook with it as well. In this episode, Lidia shares a meal where wine plays a part of each delicious dish: Sausage Crostini: a toasted piece of bread topped with sweet Italian sausage and topped with taleggio cheese; Linguine with White Clam Sauce: a simple white wine clam sauce served with linguine pasta; Braised Beef Rolls: stuffed beef rolls oozing with the flavors of prosciutto, provolone and golden raisins served in a red wine tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's an episode devoted to the fresh, simple egg, and it highlights some of Lidia's all-time favorites: Stracciatella: a simple chicken stock laced with ribbons of egg and tender spinach; Frittata with Ricotta: a luscious frittata filled with ricotta, tomatoes, onions and basil; Baked Eggplant and Eggs: a baked dish showing off of one of summer's best vegetables.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The key to a delicious meal is coaxing a lot of flavor from an ingredient, whether it is meat or vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares two ragu recipes: Lamb and Pepper Ragu: and a Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu: a heart, flavorful medley of chestnuts and mushrooms that make for a satisfying vegetarian ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American food: Is it Italian, American or a piece of Americana with Italian roots? Today Lidia pays homage to the cooking of Italian American immigrants. Recipes include: Caesar Salad; a luscious Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables; and finally Stuffed Mushrooms, a true crowd pleaser.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fruit desserts have always been an Italian tradition; they are simple, delicious and the perfect way to showcase nature's bounty. In this episode, the Lidia highlights some of her fans' preferred seasonal sweets with: Strawberries with Balsamic Vinegar, a light and creamy Panna Cotta with Seasonal Fresh Fruit; juicy Nectarines and Blueberries in Prosecco and a Plum Crostata, a free form Italian tart with juicy plums.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sweet and sour is a classic combination of flavors that can be found in almost every cuisine around the world, and in Italy it's called agrodolce and produces delicious, balanced dishes of savory and sweet.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh herbs are simply a must in Lidia's kitchen and today she makes three dishes that highlight herbs AND spices. She begins the menu with Pickled Carrots: a quick pickle of tiny carrots packed with the flavors of parsley, garlic and mint; Braised Beef in Guazzetto: rich, braised beef filled with enticing aromas and Skillet Cauliflower with Lemon and Mint: cauliflower florettes showered with lemon juice and a sprinkle of fresh mint.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Steak is a favorite in many American households, and this episode is a tribute to the nice juicy dish and showcase not only one of Lidia's preferred preparations but two other recipes that work well for a special steak house evening at home. Featured recipes include Seared Steak with Mushroom Sauce and Braised Escarole; Baked Potatoes with Pancetta and Oregano; and an Almond Cake with Chocolate Chips.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italy is a garden year round, and Lidia celebrates an array of beautiful vegetable dishes including: Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; an elegant Asparagus and Scallion Salad; a refreshing Fava Sesame Dip, that pairs beautifully with flat breads and finally a Linguine with Swisschard made with walnuts and creamy fresh ricotta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and with over 460 varieties made in Italy, it leads to many mouth-watering cheesy recipes. In this episode, Lidia shares her Cheese Baked in a Crust: gorgonzola wrapped with puff pastry and baked as crispy cheesy bites; Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad: a flavorful and fresh mix of celery, artichoke and mortadella; and finally Meatloaf Ricotta: a family favorite meatloaf dish packed with three different cheeses.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Braising is a preferred technique in Lidia's kitchen and today she prepares one rich braised meat dish, along with two braised vegetable choices for the home cook. Recipes include: Beef Braised in Barolo; a Braised Kale with Bacon; and finally Braised Cauliflower.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American classics have always been favorites at the family table and in this episode, there is reason to celebrate. Today's recipes include the most iconic Italian American dish, Spaghetti and Meatballs; a Broccoli Rabe with Garlic; and a holiday must - Zeppole.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Olive oil reigns in Lidia's kitchen, and in this episode she teaches the viewer how to use it from appetizer to soup to dessert. She'll start with a delicious Tomato and Bread Salad - a delicious tossed salad of country bread and juicy ripe tomatoes known as panzanella; a nourishing Rice and Lentil Soup and a Cannoli Napoleon, a new twist on the old cannoli: ricotta cream with crunchy almonds and chocolate layered between fried pastry.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini sauteed with garlic, anchovies and capers; fried zucchini; orecchiette with clams and zucchini; sweet-and-sour zucchini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on today in Lidia's Kitchen, and she is sharing some of her best cakes. There is a Gianduia Cake - a Piedmontese tradition and a dream for hazelnut and chocolate lovers; a delicious and moist Chocolate and Zucchini Cake; and finally a nutty Walnut and Espresso Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: At the base of Italian cuisine are essential Italian ingredients and vinegar is one of them. Lidia masters the art of cooking with vinegar in this episode. She prepares a Red Cabbage and Bacon Salad in a warm bacon and balsamic vinegar dressing; Chicken in Vinegar Sauce; and a tangy garlic Savoy Cabbage and Potatoes dish.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia cooks up two Italian American favorites today in her kitchen- Lasagna with Ricotta and Fresh Mozzarella, baked to golden perfectionand Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks, pan fried and made with fresh tomato sauce and mozzarella. To round out the menu, she'll share a Perfect Simple Salad, traditionally eaten at the end of the meal in her Italian kitchen.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everyone loves pasta, and today Lidia shows you the fun and economical way to make all your friends and family happy at the dinner table with a pasta party. On the menu is Spaghetti with Anchovies and Breadcrumbs, a delicious Southern Italian favorite; a Pasta Chinja - a heart-warming Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs and Egg. Finally, Lidia will share her Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto - a complex bowl of pasta that will become a staple in your house.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Casseroles have a place in everyone's heart and home. Today Lidia shares a delicious and hearty Italian style version of Layered Casserole of Beef, Cabbage and Potatoes topped with fontina cheese - a one pot meal fit to feed any hungry crowd. Lidia then stews apples and dried fruit in her Spiced Fruit Compote and adds spices like clove and cinnamon - a heartwarming tea; Lastly, she is joined by Grandma for her Coffee Panna Cotta, an easy make-ahead dessert flavored with coffee and Sambuca.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves earthy, delicious mushrooms and today shares some of her favorite mushroom recipes that she has prepared over the years. She'll start with a Warm Mushroom Salad, a medley of warm wild mushrooms on a bed of frisee' topped with crispy pancetta and a poached egg. She'll also make Funghi Marinati, marinated button mushrooms in a flavorful mix of rosemary, orange and garlic; Her last dish is a hearty, flavorful and vegetarian Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Soups are a part of any Italian celebration, and Americans love pairing them with a salad and sandwich. Today, Lidia will combine the best of both with a unique Italian style menu of soup, salad and bruschetta. The menu includes Spicy Italian Style Vegetable Soup, Bruschetta with Ndjua - a crunchy country bread topped with a spicy sausage and a simple and delicious Skillet Peppers and Potatoes.
programme.sub-title: Spiced Up Soup and Salad Night

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves a good roast. It brings out unimaginable flavors, and the aromas from the kitchen will beckon your family to the table. Today's menu includes Red Onions Stuffed with Rice; a Roast Pork Shoulder with Roast Vegetable Sauce, and a brown sugar, bourbon and warm Baked Pineapple served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. She'll also show you how to prepare an easy dessert spread with seasonal fruits and a few store-bought sweet Italian specialties.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Simple recipes are a must for weeknight dinners, and Lidia always looks for those that that deliver a burst of flavor. In this episode, she will share some of her favorite quick weeknight dinner ideas. She starts with a Sausage Crostini, made of sweet Italian sausage topped with Taleggio cheese. She then prepares a Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce; an iconic creamy Italian American pasta dish and then Arugula Salad with Porcini Mushroom & Shavings of Cheese.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Entertaining comes in many forms, and today Lidia creates a menu that is perfect for an intimate gathering of friends and family. This simply elegant dinner menu includes Swordfish alla Bagnara, a delicately steamed swordfish made with an aromatic mix of lemon, capers and garlic - a traditional dish from the Calabrian town of Bagnara. She'll then do a spicy Bloody Mary, followed by a classic Lagane e Ceci - ribbons of fresh pasta made with chickpeas and pepperoncino.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When it's cold outside, Lidia's kitchen kicks into high gear. The oven is on and the stovetop is always lit. On today's menu, she'll prepare her Turkey Meatloaf with Mushroom Sauce -a real family favorite that is smothered in mushroom sauce. Vin Brulee is a mulled wine infused with warm spices; it's the perfect choice to warm up on a cold night.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Whether it's American football or Italian soccer, game day parties are always popular. Lidia believes that there is nothing like a bountiful spread of food that will fuel the guests and get them cheering. On today's menu, she serves Fried Mozzarella Sandwich Skewers; Carrot and Chickpea Dip and Pizza Rolls - made with both broccoli rabe and sausage AND ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia makes pizza the centerpiece for your next party. With a variety of toppings, a salad and dessert, you are ready to go. ON the menu is a classic Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons; individual Pizzette with toppings like onion and cheese; chicken and mushroom; pear and gorgonzola and tomato & pecorino. While you have the dough, why not try a Dessert Pizza, topped with jams, Nutella, chocolate and fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Meatballs are an all-time favorite, and Lidia creates some new versions to add to your meatball repertoire and make those parties memorable. On the menu today, she shares: Lamb Meatballs with Lemon Sauce; Leftover Meatball Panini, Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce, a crispy fried monkfish meatball made in a tomato sauce that includes raisins and pine nuts.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite desserts-one spoon dessert, one seasonal fruit based dessert and of course a baked sweet to warm up the kitchen. Her Limoncello Tiramisu is a sweet pick-me-up made with delicious limoncello zabaglione. Fruit is a natural as an Italian sweet to end a meal, and she loves to simply serve Grilled Fruit to magnify their natural sweetness. A favorite Italian cookie is the Chocolate Anise Biscotti, made with a shot of espresso.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Slow cooking does take a little time, but it is so rewarding! Today Lidia shares some classic techniques that will make show-stopping dishes for any occasion. Lidia prepares an elegant Risotto with Mushrooms, finished with parsley, cheese and butter. She'll then prepare a luscious Ziti with Pork Rib Guazzetto. Lidia then shows you how breathe new life into your risotto leftovers by breading it and frying it to make a delicious snack or serve it over a salad for a complete meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their seasons, and they know how to make delicious soups, salads and pastas with fall and winter vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares some winter garden menu ideas including a spicy Escarole and White Bean Soup, a unique and delicious Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens and a Cabbage Salad made with warm bacon dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about the grill today since Italians love a "grigliata mista" or Italian grilled platters of meats, seafood and vegetables. Today, Lidia shares a menu that your guests will love as well. On the menu is Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis; Grilled Apple and Radicchio Salad with Gorgonzola and a flavorful Tuscan Maremma Style Steak.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Tomatoes make the perfect canvas for any recipe, and in today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite dishes featuring this juicy, delicious staple of Italian cuisine. Her menu includes Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce, served over easy on top of a crunchy slice of grilled country bread; Stuffed Tomatoes, filled with a classic combination of rice, mozzarella and basil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love to celebrate life, family and friends. Lidia teaches you how to keep your guests feeling happy with a few of her favorite party tricks. The menu includes Spicy Stuffed Clams with cheesy breadcrumbs, Italian Deviled Eggs made with salsa verde and Meatless Meatballs with Cheese and Quinoa, an addictive bite-size snack. For a little extra run, she'll also show you some of her favorite fruity spritzers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Summertime is dinner party season, and Lidia loves to serve family style meals. Today, she'll create a summer menu fit for any celebration. The menu includes grilled skewers of Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini and Tomato Salsa, steamed summery Green Beans with Mint Pesto and Berry Tiramisu - Lidia's summer berry twist one of the most famous Italian desserts!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love a good picnic, and Lidia shares some of her favorite picnic foods from her childhood. The menu includes Herb Frittata Rollups, a must-have finger food rolled up with a layer of flavor packed pesto. Lidia's Pasta Salad with Tomato, Mozzarella and Green Beans is a hearty pasta salad that is perfect for any picnic. Her Blueberry and Ricotta Parfait is made with homemade ricotta, blueberry sauce, candied almonds and cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and back in the kitchen, Lidia shares her favorite cheesy appetizers - Baked Goat Cheese, Fava, and Artichoke Dip, baked to golden to perfection; and Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a recipe Lidia often makes when cooking for her family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shows you how to brunch Italian-style. On the menu are Herb Frittata Roll-Ups, a wonderful appetizer to pass around at a cocktail party or for a buffet brunch; Pancetta with Fennel-Flavored Eggs and Apples, a delicious breakfast or brunch dish served with lots of crusty bread; and Potato and Egg Frico, a favorite breakfast dish in Lidia's family, in which potatoes and cheese are baked together.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love entertaining and celebrating life with family, friends, and food. Today, Lidia shares recipes that fit any kind of party. She starts with Stewed Savory Peppers, a delicious antipasto, especially when served with lots of grilled or toasted bread. Next, she makes Pear Bellini, a fruity and bubbly cocktail guests can sip on while enjoying antipasti; and who doesn't love fried balls of rice? Lidia shows viewers how to make Rice Balls with Sausage Ragù.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: On today's menu, Lidia serves Chicken and Sausage Bites with Apple Cider Vinegar Sauce, made with rosemary, vinegar, and honey. Fried food always hits the spot and next on the menu is Fried Onion Rings, made Italian-style with Grana Padano cheese added to the batter for flavor and crunch; and finally, Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms is a rich dish that is perfect for colder months.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta is a staple in any Italian home and today, Lidia prepares three pasta recipes that will become staples in your kitchen. The first dish on the menu is a quick Ziti with Kale Pesto and Crispy Bacon, a delicious way to recycle any kale pesto leftovers in the fridge. She then makes a delicious summertime pasta made with plum tomatoes, Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto, and finally Campanelle with Shrimp and Fennel, made with "little bells" that carry the chunky sauce so well.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about stress-free cooking for a holiday celebration or special occasion. Lidia makes Marinated Mushrooms that can be part of an antipasto spread or as a nibble with drinks. Vin Brûlé, the Italian version of mulled wine, is a warm and welcoming drink to make for any holiday celebration. Last on the menu is Turkey Breast with Apricots, an easy and quick way to serve turkey without having to cook a whole turkey.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her all-time favorites - Tomato and Onion Salad alla Calabrese, a great salad to make in the summer when tomatoes are sweet and ripe. Everyone loves meatballs, and Lidia shows viewers how to use leftovers in a Leftover Meatball Panini. Finally, Lidia stuffs Pizza Rolls with broccoli rabe and sausage and with ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves entertaining and today, she shares recipes that are fit for any Italian dinner party. Bruschetta is a great party appetizer, and Lidia shares one of her favorite toppings: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta. Next on the menu is Beef and Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine, a hearty-one pol meal your guests will love.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fried foods are not eaten often in Italy, but Lidia shares some recipes no one can resist. She makes Crispy Shrimp, a huge hit in her house that is sure to become a favorite in yours too; Crispy Baked Tomatoes, plum tomatoes topped with bread crumbs and baked in the oven until crispy; and finally, Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savoy Cabbage, an ideal main course for a hungry crowd.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves cooking for her family and today, she shares some of her favorite recipes to make for her grandkids, including a refreshing and kid-friendly Cherry Almond Spritzer; a simple dessert of Grilled Fruit, which brings out the fruit's natural sweetness; and Pasta Salad with Green Beans, Tomatoes and Mozzarella, a great dish for buffets, picnics, and large family gatherings.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Olive oil is an essential staple in every Italian home. It's the easiest way to add flavor to any soup, and Lidia shows you how when making Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup. Olive oil is also used in desserts, and she makes Olive Oil Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasting enhances the flavor of any kind of meat and Lidia often makes a roast for family meals. Today's menu includes a Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon and Mushrooms; an easy and elegant Roasted Pork Loin with Cabbage and Dried Cherry Sauce; and Roasted Pear, Blueberry and Grape Compote for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Calabria is famous for its fiery salami spread, 'Nduja. It is delicious on warm grilled bread, and Lidia shows viewers how to make a Bruschetta with 'Nduja; she then makes Raw and Cooked Salad for Summer with green beans and tomatoes, a wonderful way to enjoy seasonal vegetables.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about rice, and Lidia teaches viewers how to master the technique of making risotto. She starts with an Italian classic, Risotto with Mushrooms; next is Red Onions Stuffed with Rice. No food should be wasted, and Lidia shows viewers how to use risotto leftovers by making Fried Risotto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table and today, Lidia shares a simple menu for a party based around fish. In the summertime, she likes to turn on the grill and make Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini with Tomato Salsa. She serves them with Seared Salmon Paillards with Arugula Salad; and finally, Cody Hogan from Lidia's Kansas City joins Lidia in the kitchen and they make Monkfish Meatballs served in tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves bringing people together in her kitchen, and she shares two recipes that are wonderful for a buffet-style meal, her favorite way of entertaining guests. She starts with a quick and easy Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini with a sauce of garlic, butter, white wine, lemon, bread crumbs and parsley. Next on the menu is one of Lidia's favorite soups, Clam Soup, served with plenty of grilled bread on the side.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: With the oven on, Lidia creates sweet and savory dishes her viewers can easily make at home. Gratins are delicious, and she starts with a Leek and Prosciutto Gratin made with Gruyère and walnuts; next is Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate, marvelously moist inside and with a crispy, caramelized exterior. While the oven is still on, she bakes crumbly and chewy Raspberry and Walnut Butter Cookies for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares recipes that are quick to whip up and ideal for days when you don't have much time to cook. She starts off by making Green Beans with Mint Pesto, a fresh alternative to the well-known green beans with butter. For a sweet treat, Lidia makes Chunky Cherry Bread Pudding, one of her favorite ways to recycle day-old bread. Next on the menu is Maremma-Style Steak, an impressive steak that anyone can make at home.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When hosting an Italian-style cocktail party, all you need is some drinks, a nice selection of appetizers, and you're set! Back in the kitchen, Lidia creates a menu for the perfect cocktail party. She makes Mussels with Zucchini Salsa Verde, a small appetizer guests can slurp down while sipping on a cocktail. She then makes Bloody Mary, a classic cocktail everyone loves. Corn and apricots work wonderfully together, and Lidia ends with making Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia remembers some of her fondest childhood recipes that were made by her Grandmother Rosa in Italy. Recipes include Mussels Triestina and Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto. A fun and fruity Fruit Smash Soda is shared with her mother, Erminia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia talks about growing up and family traditions in this episode. Featured recipes include Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a Roasted Garlic Crostini and Papperdelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms. A refreshing "Panache" is shared with her mother Erminia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's mother, Erminia, is known to all as "Grandma." She is known for her laughter, singing and entertaining culinary moments with Lidia. In this episode, featured recipes include Corn and Zucchini Minestra, Fried Risotto and Beef & Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine. "Salute" to Grandma!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American classics are what Lidia discovered as a young 12 year old arriving in America. In this episode, she shares some of her favorites: Bolognese Sauce; Asparagus Salad and a lighter and more contemporary version of the Chicken Pizzaiola.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: We all love the rustic feeling of an Italian trattoria that serves delicious comfort food. This episode features some trattoria favorites incluing: Linguine with Clams and Broccoli; Burrata with Grilled Bread and a special Almond Tart from the heel of Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grains are back in style, yet Italians have been using them for centuries. Lidia shares some of her favorite grain based recipes in this episode including: Risotto with Mushrooms; Barley, Kale & Butternut Squash Risotto; and Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savory Cabbage.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are so many varieties of cheese in Italy, and today's recipes feature some delicious ones. Lidia will make a Crostata with Mushrooms and Onion; A quick Salad and Chicken "Involtini" with Kale Pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia grew up along the Adriatic sea so picnics at the beach were a common occurrence. Recipes in this episode include some seafood classics from the southern part of Italy including Orecchiette with Peas and Asparagus; Mussels with Farro, Cannellini and Chickpeas and a quick and delicious Chocolate Fig dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The stove can do a lot of work in any home kitchen, and many recipes can be created simultaneously. In this episode, Lidia shares recipes for: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta; Ziti with Kale and Crispy Bacon; and Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

programme.sub-title: Senos en la carretera; Todo te acusa

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José cayó en depresión y su esposo Juan le ayuda con un medicamento llamado ketamina que lo droga. Además, el hermano de Marla es menor de edad y junto a otro amigo mataron al papá de José.
programme.sub-title: Tratamiento en las calles; Niño condenado

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El padre Lázaro no puede con la presión: quiere hablar con el obispo. Ernesto le pide a Chacorta que le dé un susto. Finalmente, en la casa de Danilo, Victoria y Aurelio se conocen.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los hombres de Chacorta descubren que el padre Lázaro iba a hablar con Garnica, y lo silencian; no dejan cabos sueltos. Por recuperar a su hijo, Matilde está decidida a entregar a Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: A Matilde le tortura la idea de no volver a ver a su hijo, y el Chema le sugiere que lo secuestre. Leonor desconfía del suicidio del padre Lázaro: le pide a Garnica que presione a los Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria y Danilo se besan, y ella no sospecha que se está enamorando de Aurelio Casillas. Ambos confiesan sentirse atraídos el uno por el otro. Mónica confirma su embarazo.

programme.desc: Mónica quiere sorprender a Aurelio con su embarazo, pero se lo encuentra en la cama con Victoria. Se hace pasar por su hermana y, a solas, jura no perdonarlo si él se enamora de otra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria sube en las encuestas y eso preocupa a Elsa, quien, en un intento desesperado por ganar votantes, le propone a Max cerrar Villa Catalina. El Chema comienza a interesarse en Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa visita a Victoria y le propone una tregua para trabajar juntas contra el narcotráfico. Max está dispuesto a perder el juicio de Ximena para demostrar con quién está su fidelidad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema ordena la emboscada para recuperar al hijo de Matilde; cuando ella se arrepiente, ya es demasiado tarde. Mientras trata de escapar con sus nietos, doña Alba es brutalmente herida.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba es sometida a una cirugía, ha perdido mucha sangre y se debate entre la vida y la muerte. Aurelio sospecha que Matilde y el Chema están detrás. Ximena es condenada a prisión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio averigua quién es en verdad el escolta de Matilde, y le dice que se despida de su hijo. Los Casillas le declaran la guerra al Chema, y averiguan dónde se esconden sus hombres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde trata de reconciliarse con Chacorta, pero ya tiene los minutos contados: él no le perdona la traición. Lo importante ahora para los Casillas es hacer pagar al Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.desc: Tras la muerte de Heriberto, Aurelio declara la guerra para vengarlo: tiene ganas de matar a medio mundo. Todos se preparan para lo peor. Victoria le pone más protección a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio envía a Chacorta para ajustar cuentas con Leonor e Ignacio por la muerte de Heriberto: la orden es asesinarlos a todos. Ximena está desconsolada, y culpa a su exesposo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ignacio intenta interrogar al Manotas, pero la rabia se lo impide, y lo mata. Comienza a vengarse de todos los que participaron en la muerte de su padre. Victoria gana las elecciones.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa insiste en reunirse con el Chema, pero ya no tiene mucho que ofrecerle, y él le envenena la comida. Ernesto confiesa a su nuevo patrón que Aurelio está vivo, y le busca pruebas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila escapa con Ernesto con la esperanza de vivir juntos, y Aurelio se desespera porque sus hombres no logran encontrarla. Chacorta presiona a Víctor para que le dé información.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ernesto presenta a Rutila su nuevo jefe, que resulta ser el enemigo número uno de su padre. Aurelio le ordena a Lilo encontrar a su hija, y sospechan que su fuga está vinculada con el Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila tiene miedo, y le dice a Ernesto que la tiene que sacar de la casa de Chema lo más rápido posible. La orden es tratarla como una reina, pues aseguran que no saldrá viva de ahí.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria investiga la desaparición de Elsa, y Lucila le asegura que le contará toda la verdad sobre la relación de su jefa y el Chema. Aurelio le pide a Lay averiguar el paradero de Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema le dice a Rutila que Ernesto los traicionó a ella y a Aurelio, y le muestra una foto como prueba. Luego pide que Lay le diga a los Casillas que él tiene el tesoro que están buscando.

programme.desc: El Chema hace que Rutila grabe un video como prueba de vida para Aurelio, ya que quiere hacer negocios. Andrew obtiene material donde el general Garnica aparece con drogas, con el que pretende chantajearlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor le dice a Ignacio que descubrió su esconditre de armas, y quiere saber si él pertenece al Escuadrón de la Muerte. El Chema y Aurelio se encuentran cara a cara en Villa Catalina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio negocia con el Chema la libertad de Rutila, pero antes deben repartirse los territorios para evitar una guerra. Andrew presiona a Lay: quiere saber sobre sus vínculos con los Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila seduce al Chema, y logra que él le de su número de teléfono; finalmente, él la entrega a Aurelio. Leonor le confiesa a Victoria que Ignacio trabaja para el Escuadrón de la Muerte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa entrega a Victoria y Leonor la grabación que incrimina al general Garnica. Leonor la sigue y la encuentra en Villa Catalina. Aurelio, despechado, manda a matar a Santiago.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Despechado, Aurelio envía a sus hombres a asesinar a Santiago, pero el atentado se complica cuando Ximena resulta baleada. El Chema averigua que Lay se fue a Colombia, y ordena que la maten.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena acusa a Aurelio de haber mandado a matar a Santiago, y él le ruega no decirle nada a sus hijas. Rutila la ve morir y le dice a su padre que lo hará pagar por esa muerte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La tormentosa relación de Mónica y Aurelio se quiebra: él le confiesa que sus hombres mataron accidentalmente a Ximena, y que nunca dejó de amarla. Victoria ordena allanar el rancho de Danilo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria se horroriza cuando descubre que Danilo Ferro es en realidad Aurelio Casillas. Chacorta alerta a su hermano de abandonar el funeral de Ximena, porque los de la Marina vienen por ellos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila llama a su padre, le dice que se acostó con su peor enemigo y le da pistas de dónde está. Ahora los Casillas quieren acabar con el Chema, pero solo logran atraer a la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria le tiende una trampa a Aurelio, pero es ella quien paga las consecuencias por traicionarlo. Leonor se enfrenta al Señor de los Cielos, y luego de tantos años, al fin logra capturarlo.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: Understanding the mark left on the American West by its earliest colonists; the Spaniards, who introduce horses; the French, who develop a complex trade system; the English, who have little interest in colonizing the west of the Appalachians.
programme.sub-title: The West in the Colonial Era

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: After the Revolutionary War, the land between the Appalachians and the Mississippi becomes part of the new republic; how the territory is organized; the Northwest Ordinance of 1787 creates a new set of rules that clashes with old realities.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: The journey of the two explorers who map the Louisiana Purchase between 1804 and 1806; how Lewis and Clark fit into the tradition of explorers looking for a water route to the Pacific; the political and geographic history of the Louisiana Purchase.

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: Fur traders and mountain men play an integral part in exploring and mapping the American West; why fur is a precious commodity; how John Jacob Astor dominates the American fur trade; how famous mountaineers like Jedediah Smith become legends.
programme.sub-title: The Fur Trade and the Mountain Men

programme.title: The American West: History, Myth, and Legacy
programme.desc: One of the most dismal episodes in the story of the American West; the forced migration of the "Five Civilized Tribes" under the Indian Removal Act of 1830; it is this ordeal that the Cherokee come to call the "Trail of Tears".

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.desc: The experiences of Julia, the daughter of Caesar Augustus; a window into the way many pre-modern societies sought to control morality; Julia's life of thwarted potential; understanding what women had to overcome to make a mark on history.

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400

programme.sub-title: Herodias Has John the Baptist Beheaded

programme.title: Warriors, Queens, and Intellectuals: 36 Great Women Before 1400
programme.desc: The end of Iron Age Britain and the birth of Roman Briton; the valiant but thwarted rebellion of the Celtic warrior queen, Boudicca; how Boudicca was motivated by personal tragedy; the revival of Boudicca's legacy by Queen Victoria.

programme.desc: Nero's reputation for excess and cruelty; how Poppaea became the wife of the mad emperor; how Poppaea's religious sympathies likely influenced Nero's persecution of Christians; a complex story of spiritual zeal and vicious cruelty.

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: Exploring the reasons piracy endures from ancient times until today; why it is so difficult to both define and eradicate; how one can understand the rule of law and the rights of nations and individuals on the high seas and in borderless realms.

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: Examining popular pirate legends; discovering which aspects include some truth and which contain none at all; pirate literature can teach a lot about the jolly roger, gold-filled treasure chests, the pirate Edward Thatch and more.

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates
programme.desc: Pirates want money or anything they can turn into money; consequently, they usually wish for a speedy surrender, do not want a battle and rarely sink captured ships; the many tactics pirates use to apprehend their prey in the age of sails.

programme.title: The Real History of Pirates

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: Labs that provide DNA ancestry information use hundreds of thousands of ancestry-information markers, or AIMs; learning about the AIMs that relate to major identifiable lineages; what can be gleaned from mitochondrial DNA and Y-DNA.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: There are many social issues affecting an individual's emotional response to receiving DNA ancestry results; how the reciprocal engagement method can help families face unexpected ancestry results; tips to consider before ordering one's own test.

programme.title: King Arthur: History and Legend

programme.title: King Arthur: History and Legend

programme.title: King Arthur: History and Legend

programme.title: The Historical Jesus

programme.title: The Historical Jesus

programme.title: The Historical Jesus

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: Scholars who have devoted their lives to studying the ancient sources about Jesus come to varying conclusions; seeing what can be learned about what Jesus most likely says and does by working from a strictly historical perspective.

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: Beginning the study of the historical Jesus by examining the world within which the Christian religion is born; this world is largely populated by "pagans" who, unlike the Jews and then later the Christians, believe not in one but in many gods.

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: The work of German writer D. F. Strauss argues that the Gospels are best understood as containing history-like stories that intend to convey truth but do not occur as they are narrated; why most scholars find his approach illuminating.

programme.title: The Historical Jesus
programme.desc: Scholars question the historical accuracy of some gospel accounts not out of hostility toward Christianity, but because of historical evidence; what this evidence is; how historians assess it.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: What archeologists actually do; the nature and scope of their work; misconceptions about the field; tracing the history of archeology, from its beginnings with the ancient Babylonian king Nabonidus to archeological luminaries of the 20th century.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: Traveling to the sites of Pompeii and Herculaneum, which are destroyed by the 79 A.D. eruption of Mount Vesuvius; the history of their excavation; the preservation of buildings, objects and human remains; discovering details of ancient Roman life.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: Following the exploits of Heinrich Schliemann as he looks for Homer's Troy; learning about his dig through nine stratified cities; the finds; the debates over which city is Troy; tracing subsequent work at the site; examining the conclusions.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: The history of finds in Mesopotamia; the 19th-century unearthing of the Assyrian palaces at Nimrud and Nineveh, with their libraries of cuneiform texts; contemplating the 20th-century discovery of the treasures of the "Death Pits of Ur".

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: Asking whether genes determine one's essential nature and identity, or one builds their own identity; exploring the essentialist and constructed philosophies; how one might incorporate aspects of both into their own view of personal identity.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: Labs that provide DNA ancestry information use hundreds of thousands of ancestry-information markers, or AIMs; learning about the AIMs that relate to major identifiable lineages; what can be gleaned from mitochondrial DNA and Y-DNA.
programme.sub-title: What Genetic Testing Brings to Ancestry

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: There are many social issues affecting an individual's emotional response to receiving DNA ancestry results; how the reciprocal engagement method can help families face unexpected ancestry results; tips to consider before ordering one's own test.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA

programme.sub-title: When Family Narrative Meets Genetic Testing

programme.title: King Arthur: History and Legend

programme.title: War in the Modern World
programme.desc: In the course's inaugural episode, begin to explore the transformation of violent conflicts between major world powers by delving into a particularly recent example: America's 20-year war in Afghanistan.

programme.title: War in the Modern World

programme.title: War in the Modern World

programme.title: War in the Modern World

programme.title: War in the Modern World
programme.desc: As war rages on across the globe, China has to contend with civil war; exploring the war from its colonial roots to the establishment of the People's Republic of China; how the U.S.S.R. and the United States get involved in the conflict.
